description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Northrop Grumman is hiring an Associate Cyber Systems Engineer to help design, implement, and maintain secure, resilient infrastructure for mission-critical applications. The role contributes to network, cloud, and endpoint security through vulnerability assessment, automation, incident response, security documentation, penetration testing, and integration of security controls.
Associate Cybersecurity Engineer supporting secure network architecture, vulnerability remediation, security automation, and SIEM incident analysis

Responsibilities:
• Assist in the design and deployment of secure network architectures (firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS)
• Conduct vulnerability assessments and support remediation efforts
• .Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for security monitoring and patch management
• Participate in security incident response drills and log analysis using SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, Elastic)
• Contribute to security hardening guides and documentation for cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)
• Perform penetration testing of internal applications under guidance and report findings.Work with cross-functional teams (DevOps, IT, compliance) to integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines
• Attend weekly technical briefings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and mentorship meetings

Requirements:
• Be completing or has completed their bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
• Be majoring in or having majored in Computer Science, Software Engineering or Cybersecurity and Information Assurance
• Be able to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)
• Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP), within a reasonable amount    of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs

Preferred:
• Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.70/4.0 or higher
• Previous internship/co-op or other work experience, leadership & teamwork capabilities, interpersonal communication skills, and activities (professional/community/extracurricular)
